description: A wallet's per-token positions on one chain with real profit and loss. Per token: token_address, symbol, name, bought_qty and bought_usd, sold_qty and sold_usd, avg_buy_price and avg_sell_price (USD per token), realized_pnl_usd, balance (read from the chain at request time), price_usd (latest daily price), value_usd and unrealized_pnl_usd = balance x (price_usd - avg_buy_price), null when either is unknown. Bought and sold are the wallet's priced inbound and outbound transfers of the token (a swap, a move between its own wallets and an exchange deposit all count); a transfer with no USD price (a mint, a pre-listing airdrop) is neither. Realized PnL is average cost: only units that were bought are realized, the chain's coin and its wrapped token (WETH, WBNB, WHYPE) are one position under the zero address, and Ethereum stablecoins and disabled tokens are left out. `totals` cover EVERY token the wallet traded, not only the rows returned: realized_pnl_usd, unrealized_pnl_usd (over the tokens where it is known), tokens_traded, tokens_profitable and `as_of`, when the wallet's lifetime PnL in the wallet rankings was last recomputed (updated nightly at 04:00 UTC); the positions count trades up to the latest priced transfers, so the two differ only when the wallet traded since. USD in plain dollars. `found` is false for a wallet with no priced trade. Use when the user asks 'what did this wallet make on each token' / 'is it in profit' / 'what is it holding and at what cost'; wallet_pnl_history is a daily net-flow series, not this.

limit.description: Positions returned (default 20, max 100); totals always cover every token

order.description: desc = biggest first (default), asc = biggest losses first

sort.description: Rank positions by realized PnL, unrealized PnL or current value (default realized). Unknown values sort last

name: wallet_positions
title: Wallet Positions
